headlines.title: 中国央行：将开展14000亿元买断式逆回购操作 期限为6个月（184天）
headlines.summary: 中国央行公告，为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年7月15日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展14000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为6个月（184天），到期日为2027年1月15日（遇节假日顺延）。

headlines.title_en: Cinda Securities: Major asset restructuring application accepted by CSRC.
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, July 14 - Cinda Securities announces that it, along with China International Capital Corporation (CICC) and Dongxing Securities, plans for CICC to issue A-shares to all Dongxing A-share exchange shareholders and all Cinda A-share exchange shareholders to absorb and merge Dongxing Securities and Cinda Securities. Recently, the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) has accepted administrative许可 applications related to this transaction, including the merger of CICC with Dongxing and Cinda, changes to major shareholders of Cinda Royal Fund Management, and changes to controlling shareholders of Cinda Futures, issuing Acceptance Letters (Serial Nos: 261957, 261967, 261953). The transaction is still subject to approval by the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the CSRC, and other authorities.

headlines.title: A股ETF再现大手笔买入，分析称当下点位是大资金认可的点位
headlines.summary: 亚太市场午后集体拉升，分析人士认为，两则利好消息，刺激了这波上涨：一是韩国稳市，二是A股ETF再现大手笔买入。从A股的角度来看，来自兴证金工的数据显示，7月13日三大指数的核心ETF出现较大规模净流入，其中，沪深300ETF流入84.93亿元；中证500ETF流入73.52亿元；中证1000ETF大幅增加119.23亿元。这可能意味着，当下这个点位也是大资金认可的点位。（券商中国）

headlines.title_en: A-share ETFs see large-scale buying again; analysts say current levels are recognized by big money.
headlines.summary_en: Asia-Pacific markets rallied collectively in the afternoon. Analysts attribute the surge to two positive news: South Korea's market stabilization and large-scale buying of A-share ETFs. From an A-share perspective, data from Industrial Securities Quantitative Research shows that on July 13, core ETFs tracking three major indices saw significant net inflows, with CSI 300 ETFs receiving 8.493 billion yuan, CSI 500 ETFs 7.352 billion yuan, and CSI 1000 ETFs surging by 11.923 billion yuan. This may indicate that the current levels are recognized by major capital. (Securities China)

headlines.title_en: Yangtze Optical Fibre: Expects H1 net profit to rise 711% to 914% year-on-year.
headlines.summary_en: Yangtze Optical Fibre announces that it expects net profit for the first half of the year to be approximately 2.400 billion yuan to 3.000 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 711% to 914%. During the reporting period, driven by accelerated construction of computing data centers, demand for new types of optical fiber and cable products continued to grow both domestically and internationally, improving industry supply-demand dynamics. The company leveraged its globally leading position, seized international market opportunities, and expanded computing data center-related businesses, achieving core customer expansion, product structure optimization, and profitability improvement, with operating results up year-on-year.

headlines.title_en: Sailis Medical: Expects H1 2026 net loss of 35 million to 50 million yuan.
headlines.summary_en: Saili Medical announces that it expects net profit attributable to shareholders for the first half of 2026 to be between -35 million yuan and -50 million yuan, with a reduction in loss of between 6.1192 million yuan and 21.1192 million yuan compared to the same period last year; and expects net profit excluding non-recurring gains and losses attributable to shareholders to be between -36 million yuan and -51 million yuan, with a reduction in loss of between 19.5979 million yuan and 34.5979 million yuan.

headlines.title: China’s central bank vows flexible approach as it acknowledges uneven economic picture
headlines.summary:
China’s central bank pledged to maintain a “moderately loose” monetary policy while calling for a more forward-looking, flexible and targeted approach, flagging “structural divergence” as a key domestic challenge for the first time, in a statement published on Wednesday.
The remarks – in a readout from a meeting of the monetary policy committee of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) on Saturday – came as China’s economy grows increasingly uneven, with artificial intelligence-related sectors,...

headlines.summary_zh: 中国人民银行在周三发布的声明中承诺维持“适度宽松”的货币政策，同时呼吁采取更具前瞻性、灵活性和针对性的方式，并首次将“结构性分化”列为国内关键挑战。这些言论出自中国人民银行货币政策委员会一次会议的通稿。
